sentences.text:
This writ petition is filed with the following prayers:
"i. To issue a writ of mandamus directing the 3 rd respondent to register a crime on the basis of Ext.P2 complaint and conduct investigation in the matter.
ii. To direct the 2nd respondent to issue necessary directions to the 3rd respondent to register crime.
iii. To pass such other reliefs that this Hon'ble Court deem fit and proper.

[SIC]
2. The petitioner had sustained serious injuries in a motor vehicle accident on 20.07.2025 at Kareelakulangara, Harippad, is the submission.
It is the case of the petitioner that, while the petitioner was unleashing the rope from the top of the vehicle, the petitioner fell down and sustained grievous injuries.
The petitioner was taken to Taluk Hospital, Harippad, and later referred to District Hospital, Kollam.
The grievance of the petitioner is that the 3rd respondent has not registered any case, even though a complaint was filed.
It is further submitted by the petitioner that,
only if a case is registered, the petitioner can claim compensation under the Employees Compensation Act.
Hence, this writ petition.
Heard the learned counsel for the review petitioner and the learned Public Prosecutor.
4. When this writ petition came up for consideration, this Court directed the Public Prosecutor to get instructions.
The Public Prosecutor, after getting instructions, submitted that a petition was received and a preliminary enquiry was conducted, and since there was no cognizable offence, the petition was closed.
If that is the case, the 3 rd respondent will issue a closure report to the petitioner so that the petitioner can do the needful in accordance with law.

Therefore, this writ petition is disposed of with Mohamed Mahin vs State Police Chief on 8 October, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/25933291/
2 the following directions:
1) The 3rd respondent is directed to furnish a copy of the closure report on Ext.P2 petition, within one month from the date of receipt of a copy of this judgment.
